plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Health Science, Associate of Science' program page (Major Code: 1800S), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/catalog/health-professions-department/health-science/health-science-associate-of-science/ . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the four 'Fall/Spring Semester Freshman/Sophomore Year' tables verbatim. TRUE award: Associate of Science. Total credits: 60, the catalog's published minimum ('Total Credit Hours: 60-61'); semester totals 16/14/15/15 sum exactly. Fall Freshman ALLH block: the official table lists ALLH 101 Medical Terminology (2 cr, required) AND a choice of ALLH 100 Introduction to Allied Health (2 cr) OR ALLH 160 Cultural, Historical, and Philosophical Concepts in Sport (3 cr) - the 16-17 printed semester total confirms both the required 2-cr course and the 2-or-3-cr choice are taken (12 + 2 + 2-or-3). Modeled honestly: the choice as 2 SCH (ALLH 100) for the 60-credit minimum path. Choice slots: HUMA GE / MATH GE / COMM GE / WELL GE / SOCS GE2 / HUMA GE2 are official catalog placeholders for 'any Gen. Ed.' course in that category (student choice); PROG ELEC rows are 'Program Electives' (8 credits each semester; student choice from the 16-hour program-electives list printed on the page). Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page. Footnotes: Social Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Humanities courses must be from 2 disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.'
